findings.description: CON-SUP-113 requires GET FAULTS to return the last 8 fault reports, and CON-SUP-134 specifies their order and terminator. SYS-SUP-029 requires fault history to survive resets, but SYS-SUP-034 only returns the reports held, at most 8; the set does not require retention of the most recent 8 reports.
findings.requested_change: Specify retention of the most recent 8 fault reports, or all available reports when fewer than 8 have occurred, so GET FAULTS returns the required history.
